notes: Three rounds of three tasks, written (with ground truth) BEFORE the retrieval fixes were made, so they are a held-out check and not tuned to them. medium = a single behaviour described in plain words that overlap the code's vocabulary. hard = paraphrased so the code's own words are mostly absent, with a decoy file that looks right. expert = the answer spans several files, or depends on structure a name search cannot see (duplicated logic, dependency injection, a storage key shared across files).

tasks.query: Where are GET responses cached so the same request is not sent to the server twice, and how can a caller force a fresh copy?
Where is the Accept-Language header added to outgoing requests, and why is the login call always sent in English?
Where is the server base URL put in front of relative API paths, and which URLs skip it?
Which route protection sends a visitor who is not logged in back to the home page, but remembers the page they wanted so they can return there after single sign-on?
tasks.trap: authGuard in the same file also redirects home but does not remember the page

tasks.query: When a request fails, which code waits a short moment and tries it once more, and which error statuses are never retried?
tasks.trap: session.interceptor also reacts to 401 but by refreshing the token, not by retrying after a delay

tasks.query: How does the I am not a robot box shrink to fit a narrow container, and when is it actually drawn on the page?
I want the idle logout time to come from tenant settings instead of the environment file. Which files contain the current timeout logic that has to change?
tasks.trap: the timeout parsing is duplicated; changing only one file leaves the other on the old value

tasks.query: I want to rename the browser storage key that records when the user last interacted with the site. Find every file that reads or writes it.
Before I change ProductAccessService, which components and pages depend on it?
tasks.trap: components receive the service by constructor injection, so there are no call edges from the class itself
